name: Interception
notes: The library API in interception.h provides contexts, per-device filters and precedence, wait, receive and send of strokes, and hardware ID queries. Building uses the Windows Driver Kit 7.1.0 and installing the driver needs administrator rights. The library is LGPL for non-commercial use, with separate commercial licenses.
summary: A Windows input driver and C library that captures, filters and injects keyboard and mouse strokes per device, shipped with sample programs and a command-line installer.
